title.en: Pavanar Parvaiyil Thamizhch-chol Valam (பாவாணர் பார்வையில் தமிழ்ச்சொல் வளம்)

text.en: Tamil has survived when many languages have faded.

This prose lesson begins with Bharathiyar's line that country and language are our two eyes. It says that Tamil has swum through the flood of time while many languages have melted away, and that it has so many special qualities that one wonders what richness it lacks.
The lesson looks at Tamil word wealth through the eyes of Devaneya Pavanar, who showed that Tamil words are rich, root-based and descriptive.
Terms: சொல்வளம் (word wealth), வேர்ச்சொல் (root word), மொழி and பாவாணர். Learn examples of how roots give rise to many words.
